limitations: These are targeted regressions, not a complete full-suite or cross-platform execution claim.
Accepted checks span compiler snapshots005/010 plus the formatter tool; no single full-suite run is claimed.
Volatile/atomic/lifetime and compiler ABI special paths retain their dedicated adapters.
Existing unsupported right-to-left lowered operations remain explicitly rejected.
Typed enum storage/promotion integration and omitting public properties for unnamed padding are deferred to the next authorized boundary.
Formatter only normalizes whitespace and checks syntax; it does not perform semantic rewrites.

pointerCompoundRegression.cause: Scalar implicit-conversion gate sent pointer compound assignment to integer-address arithmetic, losing element stride. SQLite yyStackEntry displacement was applied as bytes instead of sizeof(yyStackEntry)=24 elements.
pointerCompoundRegression.correction: Pointer +=/-= accepts integral displacement and retains typed pointer arithmetic in direct and localized fallback paths. EDG frontend and original C backend were not changed.
pointerCompoundRegression.acceptance: 009 expression10, including struct/array pointers, signed/negative counts, nested lvalues, consumed/discarded values, receiver single evaluation and RHS mutation. Real SQLite project acceptance is recorded separately by coordinator.

commaHeader010.semantics: Discarded comma expressions concatenate legal child statement-expression headers when neither child requires prefix statements; value-context comma behavior remains unchanged. Exact-int compound-shift counts omit identity casts.
commaHeader010.fixture: Two/three nested increment chains, continue, later operand observing prior mutation, void call and prefix-bearing bitfield fallback.
commaHeader010.arrayViewAudit: Central named InlineArray access is restricted to stable fixed array variables; index child bindings stay honored. Existing64MiB aggregate cap bounds valid int indices. Explicit address emission retains pointer identity and one-past semantics.
